## About
Vic's & Jim's Collision Center grew out of family shops. Vic Bosak founded Vic's Auto Body in Minneapolis, and Mark Bolsen, who later took it over, remembers Vic as a caring man who would stop by after retiring to greet old customers. Jim Smith founded Jim's Auto Body on Central Avenue in North East Minneapolis, and his son, Tom, took over the family business. The shops merged, and Tom Smith remains the owner.
Tom's focus is simple: keep staff and customers in the know, because good communication drives results. One reviewer said Tom "genuinely cared about making sure I understood the process every step of the way." Our staff has also been trained through the AskPatty program on dealing ethically and honestly with female customers.
Our goal is to make your vehicle repair as pain free as possible. We're rated 4.8 on Google from 147 reviews.

## Services
- Auto Body and Collision Repair: Minor or major damage, we'll handle all of it and do the job correctly from start to finish.
- Paint Services: Perfect paint matching with our PPG waterborne refinishing system.
- Paintless Dent Repair: For minor dings and dents, PDR uses tools that pull the dent out without ruining the paint. Not every dent qualifies, so we'll look at it and tell you straight.
- Computerized measuring system: Part of the range of auto body repair services at our shop.
- Truck body repair: Body work for trucks as well as cars.
- Motorhome body repair: Body work for motorhomes, not just cars.
- Fleets: Rebranding, accident management and repairs to keep your fleet on the road in its best condition.
- Lease Turn-In: Easy and affordable repairs before you turn in your lease, so there are no surprises.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work with my insurance company?
A: Yes. We work with all major insurance companies, and we'll handle the insurance company for you.

Q: Do you charge for an estimate?
A: No. Call us for a free estimate. We also offer online estimates.

Q: Can every dent be fixed with paintless dent repair?
A: Not always. Some dents can't be corrected with PDR, so bring it in and we'll find the right fix for your vehicle.

Q: Can you pick up my car?
A: Yes. We can pick up and drop off our customers.
